goal: Let the reader show only the books with one status (to-read, reading or done), or all of them.
inputs: src/books.ts holds the pure domain functions; new logic goes there with unit tests.

acceptance_criteria.statement: filterByStatus(books, status) returns only the books with that status, in their original order, without changing the input array.
The page has a status filter control above the list that updates the list when changed.

evidence.steps: Add three books, mark one reading and one done, then pick 'reading' in the filter.
evidence.expected: Only the book marked reading is listed; picking 'all' lists all three again.
